augmentations.name: Path of Protocol
augmentations.mechanics: Legacy advertised +5% recurring XP was not implemented. Cosmetic archive only.

augmentations.name: Path of Overclock
augmentations.mechanics: Implemented: +10% XP for plan activities rated High-Risk or Critical. Snapshot at first completion.

augmentations.name: Path of Resource
augmentations.mechanics: Implemented: +5 percentage points to recognition chance. Credits are a display stat, not spendable currency; the old +15% credits claim was not implemented.

augmentations.name: Path of Neural Efficiency
augmentations.mechanics: Cosmetic archive: no MP spending exists, so the advertised discount has no mechanical effect.

augmentations.name: Path of Redundancy
augmentations.mechanics: Cosmetic archive: HP had no gameplay use. No health or rest resource is required.

augmentations.name: Path of Resonance
augmentations.mechanics: Cosmetic archive: the advertised Hardware XP bonus was not implemented.
